audience: teams that build and run chatbots in Botpress

useCases.title: Check the health of a bot
useCases.text: Read the logs, the issues and the analytics of a bot. Look for errors after a new release.

useCases.title: Read a customer conversation
useCases.text: List the conversations of a bot and read the messages of one. Use it to see where the bot failed.

useCases.title: Look up the rows of a bot table
useCases.text: List the tables of a bot and find rows that match a filter.

useCases.title: Search the knowledge base files
useCases.text: Search the files of a bot for matching passages and read the details of a file. Use it to check what the bot knows.

useCases.title: See who has access to a workspace
useCases.text: List the workspaces, the members and the bots of an account.
